blocks.html: Any combination of fixtures within one bathroom group is permitted to be vented by a vertical wet vent. The vertical wet vent shall be considered the vent for the fixtures and shall extend from the connection of the dry vent down to the lowest fixture drain connection. Each wet-vented fixture shall connect independently to the vertical wet vent. Fixture drains shall connect above or at the same elevation as the water closet fixture drain. The dry-vent connection to the vertical wet vent shall be an individual or common vent serving one or two fixtures.
